criteria.reason: Opens 'I wouldn't go next spring,' then reasons through risk, timing, and children — direct view, no table.
Names dream versus responsibility to children and wife, plus the cost of staying — conflict explicitly articulated.
Advises rather than commands; affirms adults may take big risks and suggests deciding jointly with his wife.
Irreversibility (death, unrepeatable childhood) is central; middle paths: postpone eight years, oxygen 8000er, hard 7000er, involve wife.

position: Wouldn't go next spring; postpone the no-oxygen attempt about eight years
factual_errors: Claims Ed Viesturs finished all fourteen 8000ers without oxygen at 49; he was 45.
summary: A direct, honest view that names the dream-versus-family conflict, weighs irreversibility, offers postponement and lower-risk alternatives, and leaves the choice to him.
